title: Australia news live: Coles blames competitor’s Ooshies for slowing sales; young people the first generation to earn less than their parents at same age
text: 19.36 EDT Coles blames Ooshies for hurting its sales as it reports $1.09bn profit Luca Ittimani Coles reported growing profit from its supermarkets despite a slump in alcohol sales and a delayed hit from Woolworths’ Disney “Ooshie” giveaways. The company today said it grown supermarket sales by 3.7% and gained market share over the year to June. Growth had continued into July but slumped amid a “competitor’s collectibles campaign” – a reference to the “Ooshie” plastic figurines. Coles said its digital sales boomed 26.4%, to $5.6bn, helped by a partnership with Uber Eats and improved wait times for store-based click and collect orders. Its own-brand product sales grew 6.1%, with the company singling out its cleaning, baby and ready meal range. The company said the prices of its supermarket products rose just 1.5% through the year. Supermarkets’ own calculation methods for inflation are not necessarily intuitive. Its net profit bumped up 1% to $1.09bn as a result. Profit would have been $1.25bn if not for a penalty from a federal court ruling over its payment of managers . But liquor sales fell 3.3% from the prior year. text: Burnham planning to visit US in September to lobby Trump on Ukraine Image source, EPA By Helen Sullivan Published 53 minutes ago UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham says he plans to travel to the US next month with European leaders to lobby US President Trump on Ukraine's defence needs. In an interview with Bloomberg, Burnham said, "I'm looking forward to going to New York in September," when the UN General Assembly will meet. Photograph: Trevor Bexon/Getty Images Nevada Fast-moving Hawk wildfire is about 27% contained in Reno, Nevada, officials say Tens of thousands are still under evacuation orders or warnings amid ‘human-caused’, wind-driven blaze Edward Helmore , Dani Anguiano , Cecilia Nowell and agencies Mon 24 Aug 2026 21.28 EDT First published on Mon 24 Aug 2026 09.17 EDT Share Prefer the Guardian on Google The Hawk fire is about 27% contained, authorities said on Monday afternoon, two days after the fast-moving , wind-driven wildfire sparked near Reno, Nevada . Authorities added that 23,000 people are under a “go-now” order and 40,000 people are under a “get-set” warning, an improvement from the 90,000 Nevadans under evacuation orders or warnings on Monday morning. More than 900 personnel are currently assigned to the fire, said Richard Edwards, the chief of Truckee Meadows Fire Protection District, who added that first responders had identified 32 destroyed and six damaged homes. “We expect those numbers to increase as damag
author: Edward Helmore, Dani Anguiano , Cecilia Nowell and agencies

text: Топ-10 экономик Европы по паритету покупательной способности. Но если не считать Россию Европой, то тогда первая Германия. Она когда-то и в списке с Россией была первой, но благодаря чудесной политике уступила РФ в рейтингах ВВП по ППС. За последние пару лет отрыв только вырос и в мире РФ давно занимает устойчивое 4-е место обгоняя Германию и Японию. Выше подняться впрочем нам не светит, первая тройка - Китай, США, Индия - слишком далеко.
author: Boris Rozhin

text: Министр финансов США Скотт Бессент объявил о начале операции "Экономический изгой", что знаменует начало "экономического Д-Дня" против Исламской Республики Иран: "Сегодня, по указанию президента Трампа, Министерство финансов США начало операцию "Экономический изгой"... Наша цель – прервать все экономические связи, которые поддерживают этот тиранический режим, пока Тегеран не останется в одиночестве." @genshtab24
